mathematical_scope: Fixed positive convex reflection-centroid weights for the real nonsingular hub-and-spoke unit-normal family; all integer dimensions at least two and 0<c<1.
scientific_integrity: Exact proof furnished; finite checker tests are supplemental. No independent scholarly audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Not an optimization over arbitrary signed weights, changing weights, separate global relaxation, or arbitrary normal frames.
An exact spectral-gap asymptotic does not establish floating-point or wall-clock performance.
Historical originality may depend on specialized E-optimal design results not inspected in full.
title: Unique optimal convex reflection weights on hub-and-spoke linear systems
